text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rulership came over to talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll refrain from entering the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's the time of year when Junior Class 
GⅠs are concentrated, but I've already 
decided to "lie low."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Respecting Rulership's wishes, we decided 
to skip racing in early December.
